title: Package metadata
summary: Package identity, exports, and packaging surface from package.json.
body:
{
 "title": "Package metadata",
 "summary": "Package identity, exports, and packaging surface from package.json.",
 "packageName": "@incursa/ui-kit",
 "version": "1.6.1",
 "license": "Apache-2.0",
 "repository": "git+https://github.com/incursa/ui-kit.git",
 "homepage": "https://github.com/incursa/ui-kit#readme",
 "exports": {
 ".": {
 "style": "./dist/inc-design-language.css",
 "sass": "./src/inc-design-language.scss",
 "default": "./dist/inc-design-language.js"
 },
 "./web-components": {
 "style": "./dist/web-components/style.css",
 "default": "./dist/web-components/index.js"
 },
 "./web-components/style.css": "./dist/web-components/style.css",
 "./dist/inc-design-language.css": "./dist/inc-design-language.css",
 "./dist/inc-design-language.min.css": "./dist/inc-design-language.min.css",
 "./src/inc-design-language.scss": "./src/inc-design-language.scss",
 "./src/_inc-theme.scss": "./src/_inc-theme.scss",
 "./src/_inc-tokens.scss": "./src/_inc-tokens.scss"
 },
 "files": [
 "dist",
 "src",
 "README.md",
 "LLMS.txt",
 "AI-AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md",
 "NOTICE"
 ],
 "publishConfig": {
 "access": "public"
 },
 "main": "./dist/inc-design-language.js",
 "style": "./dist/inc-design-language.css",
 "sass": "./src/inc-design-language.scss",
 "notes": [
 "The package exposes both the CSS-first surface and the optional same-package web-components layer.",
 "The dist/ directory is the public build output root."
 ],
 "relatedUris": [
 "ui-kit://install",
 "ui-kit://update",
 "ui-kit://overview"
 ]
}
